name: As-Salt - The Place of Tolerance and Urban Hospitality
description: As-Salt is a hillside town in west-central Jordan, draped across three hills in the Balqa highlands. Its streets are lined with some 650 historic buildings of glowing yellow limestone, built mostly between the 1860s and 1920s by merchants and craftsmen who blended Art Nouveau touches with local styles. Muslims and Christians lived side by side here, sharing a famed tradition of welcoming guests.
